chunks: Al-Baqir and Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Two rak'ahs of salat performed with siwak are better than seventy rak'ahs without siwak."

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: better; more excellent in merit and reward
key_terms.بِسِوَاكٍ: with siwak, meaning with tooth-cleaning before or for prayer
key_terms.سَبْعِينَ: seventy, indicating a great comparative increase
key_terms.صَلَاةُ: salat (prayer), the act of ritual worship being discussed

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of using siwak before salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the merit of using siwak in connection with salat (prayer). It shows that observing this recommended act greatly enhances the excellence and reward of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.118 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) and Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Two units of prayer performed with siwak (tooth cleaning) are better than seventy units of prayer without siwak."
